words.gloss: to those who do not experience

literal: To those who do not experience [it] the experienced pain you tell; the sea you do not punish, may you live long, O heart!
translation: O heart, you go to tell our suffering to the one who feels no love for us, yet you do not silence the roaring sea that torments us here. May you live long!
modern: நெஞ்சே! நம் மீது அன்பு இல்லாதவரிடம் சென்று நம் துன்பத்தைச் சொல்கிறாய்; ஆனால் இங்கிருந்து நம்மைத் துன்புறுத்தும் கடலின் ஒலியை அடக்க மாட்டாயா? நீ வாழ்வாயாக!
explanation: The heroine ironically blesses her heart while pointing out its foolishness. She suffers from lovesickness, which is aggravated by the relentless roaring of the sea at night. Her heart constantly thinks of going to her lover, who does not share her pain, to tell him of her sorrow. Yet, it does nothing to silence the sea that is immediately tormenting her, showing its misplaced efforts.
